weave.text: You can hear her before you see her. {says}. Every family has a soundtrack, and that line is ours.

Home has a smell, and it is {s_home|low}. Wherever we go, that is the smell of being safe.
And nothing in the world tastes like {dish|low}. Restaurants have tried. Restaurants have failed.
The lesson she gave us without ever sitting us down? {s_taught}. We are still learning it. We are still grateful.
